components.name: Employee device
components.resp: Trusted device: signs proposals, approvals, one-off exceptions, submit and cancel requests; holds the employee’s signed standing terms; disputes automatic payments.

components.name: Agent presenter
components.resp: Scripted synthetic presenter: discover, evaluate, select, explain. Never approves or pays.

components.name: Employer
components.resp: Publishes a signed, bounded mandate: the co-payment authority.

components.name: Benefit policy
components.resp: Pure function: splits the total. The employee covers the remainder; their standing terms decide who must authorise it.

components.name: Coordinator
components.resp: Verifies every signed request against its caller’s key, purchase and version, and checks who may make it; decides which authority each purchase needs, binds approvals to versions, rechecks authority at initiation, derives state from legs. Submits on a payer’s request, or by itself under on_ready.

components.name: Settlement orchestrator
components.resp: Inside the coordinator: groups shares by ledger, reserves every share, commits bank shares then the digital-euro group, and releases or compensates. Holds no money.

components.name: Keys, allowances + standing terms
components.resp: One authority registry: binds keys to holders and accepts only verified, next-version allowances and standing terms; logs its own publications.

components.name: Benefit + auto-pay ledgers
components.resp: Employer benefit per day, employee auto-pay budget per month: reserve at submission, consume on completion, release on a confirmed failure or return.

components.name: Providers
components.resp: Each payer’s provider keeps that payer’s bank account and digital-euro pseudonym, and reserves, commits, releases or returns only its own customer’s share. Each payee has a receive-only shop provider.

components.name: Merchants
components.resp: Catalogue offers out; sign offer changes and refunds as payee; receipts land in the linked bank (zero holdings).

components.name: Trace / run record
components.resp: One append-only audit log; the digest proves a run was reproduced.

components.name: Digital-euro settlement
components.resp: Digital euro held by pseudonym, with holding limits; holds, same-ledger atomic groups, funding from and defunding to bank. Only the account holder’s provider may act on it.

components.name: Bank transfers
components.resp: Moves committed bank money from a payer’s provider to a shop’s provider. Holds nothing per customer; each transfer settles on its own.

components.name: Privacy profiles + party views
components.resp: Freezes each purchase’s signed privacy profile (employer_benefit_v1 or split_bill_v1) and projects it per party: viewFor() checks the frozen terms and the requested facet, or refuses.
